purpose: Requalify six existing generic engine Commander/multiplayer rule test classes against exact current main after source drift. No actual frozen eight-deck initializes or sample outcomes. These are necessary but insufficient to admit Phase2 games.
negative_boundaries: No test case can stand in for exact gameplay across three pod templates.
Source branch main lacks the historical Phase2-specific CommanderPodCapabilityTest path; do not invent passing coverage.
Single- or synthetic-pod passing tests cannot certify all partner/commander setup, masked opponent action, or card mechanics.
Fail if any expected JUnit class missing, any failed/errors/skips, any changed test source, or any unauthorized code delta.
